name: AI Watchdog Analyst
description: Analyzes Drupal logs (Watchdog) using AI to suggest solutions.
project_description: AI Watchdog Analyst adds an AI-powered "Analyze" action to Drupal's Watchdog (dblog) log viewer. On the log overview (/admin/reports/dblog) each Warning-or-worse entry gains a "🤖 Analyze" button that opens a modal with an AI-generated solution; individual log-event pages get an "Analyze with AI" button that renders the analysis beneath the log-details table. The module builds a prompt from the selected watchdog row (type, severity, message with variables substituted, location and referer), detects whether the log type maps to a contrib module and enriches the prompt with a drupal.org project URL, then calls a chat model through the AI module's provider plugin system. Responses are markdown, converted to HTML via league/commonmark, and cached for 24 hours per log type+message. Provider, model and the system prompt are configurable at /admin/config/ai/watchdog-analyst. Requires core dblog and the AI module (^1.0) with at least one configured chat provider. Supports Drupal 10 and 11.
